# Bounty Docs

> This is the public Bounty documentation site at https://docs.bountygrowth.com/.

Bounty Docs explains how to use Bounty, including integrations, product workflows, data setup, analytics, campaigns, ads, creatives, actions, agents, and the app-hosted MCP server where documented.

## Related Bounty properties

- Public landing page: https://www.bountygrowth.com/
- Privacy Policy: https://www.bountygrowth.com/privacy
- Terms and Conditions: https://www.bountygrowth.com/termsandconditions
- Support and data requests: https://www.bountygrowth.com/support
- Authenticated app: https://app.bountygrowth.com/
- MCP setup: https://app.bountygrowth.com/settings — copy the MCP URL and follow the instructions there.

## Guidance for LLMs and crawlers

- Treat https://docs.bountygrowth.com/ as the public Bounty documentation source.
- Use https://www.bountygrowth.com/ for public marketing and company information.
- Use https://app.bountygrowth.com/ only as the authenticated product app for logged-in users.

## Public documentation index

- [Bounty Docs](https://docs.bountygrowth.com/index.md): Bounty Docs is the public documentation site for Bounty.
- [Bounty App Quickstart](https://docs.bountygrowth.com/quickstart.md): Get started with the Bounty web app.
- [Integrations](https://docs.bountygrowth.com/integrations/overview.md): Learn how Bounty connects customer-authorized marketing, analytics, CRM, and warehouse data.
- [Google Ads Integration](https://docs.bountygrowth.com/integrations/google-ads.md): Bounty-owned OAuth, advertiser-account discovery and selection, credential protection, AI use, and disconnect behavior.
- [Google Analytics Integration](https://docs.bountygrowth.com/integrations/google-analytics.md): Bounty-owned OAuth, GA4 property discovery and selection, credential protection, AI use, and disconnect behavior.
- [Google Search Console Integration](https://docs.bountygrowth.com/integrations/google-search-console.md): Read-only OAuth, property selection, daily search-performance Datasets, organization isolation, AI use, and deletion behavior.
- [Legal](https://docs.bountygrowth.com/legal.md): Canonical policy links and Bounty trust documentation.
- [Data Processing Addendum](https://docs.bountygrowth.com/dpa.md): Data-processing terms that apply when Bounty handles Customer Personal Data on a customer's behalf.
- [Subprocessors](https://docs.bountygrowth.com/subprocessors.md): Vendors that may process Customer Data, including AI and integration providers.
- [Security Controls](https://docs.bountygrowth.com/security-controls.md): Bounty's public security control summary.
- [MCP Server](https://docs.bountygrowth.com/mcp/overview.md): Copy your MCP URL from Bounty Settings and follow the setup instructions to connect your MCP client.
